tagline.en: NVIDIA's omni-modal reasoning model — understands and answers questions over images, video, and audio together.
tagline.zh: NVIDIA 的全模态推理模型——统一理解图像、视频与音频并回答相关问题。

en: OmniVinci is an omni-modal understanding model from NVIDIA. Rather than generating media, it reasons over what you give it — an image, a video clip, or an audio track — and answers questions about the content in natural language.

It handles a spread of tasks under one model: general multimodal reasoning, audio reasoning, image question answering, and video question answering. That makes it a single entry point when your input mixes several modalities and you want a unified answer.

In WorldFoundry, OmniVinci runs as an understanding route: you supply media plus a question or instruction, and it returns a text response. Model assets are fetched from the published checkpoint before a run.
zh: OmniVinci 是 NVIDIA 推出的全模态理解模型。它不生成媒体,而是对你给出的内容——图像、视频片段或音频——进行推理,并用自然语言回答与内容相关的问题。
它用一个模型覆盖多类任务:通用多模态推理、音频推理、图像问答与视频问答。当输入混合了多种模态、你又希望得到统一答案时,它就是一个便捷的入口。
在 WorldFoundry 中,OmniVinci 作为理解路径运行:你提供媒体加上一个问题或指令,它返回文本回答。运行前会从发布的 checkpoint 拉取模型资产。

whenToUse.en: Use OmniVinci when you need to ask questions about images, video, or audio — captioning, content Q&A, or reasoning that spans more than one modality at once.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要就图像、视频或音频提问时——如描述生成、内容问答,或跨越多种模态的推理——可以使用 OmniVinci。

notFor.en: Not a generator: it does not create images or video, only understands and answers about them. It needs its checkpoint and assets available before running.
notFor.zh: 它不是生成器:不会创建图像或视频,只做理解与问答。运行前需要准备好其 checkpoint 与资产。

en: Handles image, video, and audio inputs
Multimodal reasoning, audio reasoning, and image/video Q&A in one model
Text-out understanding route, not a media generator
zh: NVIDIA 出品的全模态理解模型
支持图像、视频与音频输入
多模态推理、音频推理、图像/视频问答同在一个模型
输出文本的理解路径,而非媒体生成器
